newsitem.title: SPAIN: S&P's confirms Banesto, Banco Santander ratings.
newsitem.headline: S&P's confirms Banesto, Banco Santander ratings.

text.p: Ratings agency Standard & Poor's affirmed on Monday its AA- long-term and A-1+ short-term ratings for Spain's Banco Santander.
It also affirmed its "A" long-term and A-1 short-term ratings for Spain's Banesto.
Banco Santander is the majority shareholder in Banesto.
The ratings come after Banco Santander agreed to buy 55 percent of Colombia's Banco Comerical Antioqueno (Bancoquia) and 90 percent of Banco de Venezuela last week.
In a statement the ratings agency also affirmed its "BBpi" rating for Bancoquia, assigned on December 16.

"Although Standard & Poor's believes these acquisitions are coherent with Santander's geographic diversification strategy, the increase in commerical banking and investment operations in Latin American is increasing the risk profile of the group," S&P's said after Santander announced it purchases.
